results.rationale: Consistency: excluding the requested viewpoint change, the gray backdrop becomes white and the glossy, detailed surface reflections become broad simplified gradients; black/red colors and the main stripe-and-vent motif remain. Instruction: the helmet changes from a three-quarter view to a symmetrical frontal orientation, but compared with the reference it is viewed noticeably from above, exposing a much taller crown, shortening the visor and narrowing the chin region; the required front view is only partially matched. Quality, edited image alone: the shell, visor, paired vents and central stripes have clean, coherent outlines and smooth shading, without noticeable generation artifacts.

Consistency: excluding hand removal and the mechanically expected ball/spring changes, the orange ball, dark coil, cream background and illustration style remain, but the rectangular base is visibly shifted upward and slightly narrowed. Instruction: the pressing hand is completely removed, leaving the ball unobstructed and no longer pressed, fully satisfying release. Knowledge: the supplied explanation requires spring elongation and a rising ball; the coil remains similarly compressed and the ball support height is nearly unchanged, so exposing the round upper ball does not depict the required rebound. Quality, edited image alone: the ball, continuous shaded coil and solid rectangular base are clearly formed with coherent contact and texture and no noticeable artifacts.
